title: ATLAS model card — regulatory-ready conformance profile
description: Cumulative on procurement-ready: adds predetermined change control (FDA/MHRA PCCP or EU AI Act Annex IV point 2(f) technical solutions for continuous compliance), a declared bias-mitigation approach, and cybersecurity measures (security posture) as currently-expressible increments toward the HTI-1 / EU AI Act Annex IV convergent gap set.
$comment: Cumulative: allOf-references procurement-ready.json so every procurement-ready constraint still applies, then adds its own increment (each nested `required` is restated down to the leaf per the note's "required does not cascade" trap; this branch defines no new properties). Bias-mitigation approach and security posture were DEFERRED at this profile's creation and have since been added to the base schema (ROADMAP:04126 Bias mitigation approach, ROADMAP:04115 Cybersecurity measures); promoted to required below. Still DEFERRED pending fields that do not yet exist in the base schema (per the note's "profiles cannot ship first" and the HTI-1/Annex IV convergent-gap list): structured training-data characterization; at least one subgroup-disaggregated performance record; at least one performance record with Test type "External"; a Maintenance object (validity/fairness monitoring, update process); a Factors declaration; a foundation-model flag; human-oversight measures; third-party/pre-trained-component disclosure. These will be added to this profile once the corresponding base-schema fields exist.
